summary: Executed backend + UI testing for P0 engraving mask/exclusions. New iteration23 backend regression suite passed (7/7). Admin mask workflow works end-to-end: isolated product creation, exclusion add/edit/delete, area shape switch, save/reload persistence, and no area.id leak in save payload. One intermittent frontend integration issue observed in preview UI (sporadic 503 leading to temporary 'A network error occurred.').

minor.issue: Existing legacy test expects 422 for out-of-engraving placement. Current approved P0 behavior allows out-of-bound placement with non-destructive clipping, so this expectation is obsolete and now fails against live behavior.

ui_bugs.issue: Intermittent temporary 'A network error occurred.' appeared during editor session while console recorded 503s for /api/studio/text-preview and some static assets in the same run.

integration_issues.flow: Customer studio editing after admin product setup
integration_issues.issue: Intermittent upstream/network instability (503) surfaced in browser automation run; backend direct endpoint replay returned 200 (5/5) afterward, suggesting non-deterministic gateway/edge issue rather than deterministic backend validation failure.

action_items: Update/replace obsolete assertions in iteration20 tests that still enforce hard boundary rejection (422) for dragged elements outside engraving area.

Investigate intermittent preview 503 path (ingress/edge/static asset serving and occasional /api/studio/text-preview visibility in browser run). Add retry/observability around preview fetches to avoid transient canvas error state.
Retest full customer path (save/reopen/cart/test-order) under longer soak once 503 intermittency is addressed.
critical_code_review_comments: PASS: Exclusion constraints are strictly validated in ProductInput (finite coords, min size 2px, circle side equality, in-photo bounds, unique IDs, max 24).
PASS: Engraving mask implementation uses non-destructive clipping with union-like hole behavior and applies in render_layers and legacy render_free path.
PASS: Admin area editor save payload did not send area.id='area' in tested flow.
RISK: Browser-observed intermittent 503s can temporarily degrade canvas preview UX even when backend endpoint is generally healthy.

success_rate.frontend: 85% (core admin mask + persistence + responsive checks passed; intermittent network/preview issue observed)

seed_data_creation: Created isolated TEST_ products/templates/drafts via automated tests; cleanup fixture included in test file for iteration23-created records.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run /app/backend/tests/test_studio_iteration23_masks_p0.py as baseline for P0 mask behavior. For UI, product id 6a4acb8c-567a-402f-9f38-45bb2091c706 was used to validate area tab persistence and responsive layout. Console log references contain intermittent 503 evidence; backend logs around same period show many successful 200 responses, so focus next run on gateway-level reproducibility and long-run frontend stability.
rca of the issue: Primary observed failure is intermittent frontend preview instability, not deterministic business logic break. Reproduction (intermittent): during studio editing after admin product save, browser console logs include sporadic 503 responses for /api/studio/text-preview and static assets, then canvas shows temporary 'A network error occurred.'. In the same environment, direct repeated API calls to /api/studio/text-preview succeeded (200, 5/5), and backend access logs show normal 200s for most matching requests. Likely mitigation path: inspect ingress/edge/network intermittency and add client-side retry or graceful recovery for preview fetch failures.
